title: Progeny Test for Generating Single Copy Homozygous Transgenic Lines in Arabidopsis thaliana
author: Akila Wijerathna Yapa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5xrg7m6
materials: Grow out some of those survived T2 seedlings.

steps.title: Prepare Arabidopsis plants
steps.instruction: Grow Arabidopsis thaliana plants for approximately 4 weeks until primary bolts appear, then clip the primary bolts to encourage the emergence of multiple secondary inflorescences.

steps.title: Inoculate Agrobacterium culture
steps.instruction: Two days before the floral dip, prepare the initial Agrobacterium tumefaciens culture.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate a single colony of transformed Agrobacterium tumefaciens into 2 mL of sterilized YEP medium.
Supplement medium with Kanamycin (50 mg/ml), Rifampicin (50 mg/ml), and the selectable antibiotic specific to the cloned plasmid.
Grow the culture for 20-24 hours at 28ºC and 250 rpm.

steps.title: Scale up Agrobacterium culture
steps.instruction: Expand the Agrobacterium culture to reach the required optical density.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of the overnight culture into 100 mL of YEP medium supplemented with appropriate antibiotics.
Grow for 20-24 hours at 28ºC and 250 rpm, or until OD600 reaches 0.8.
Use YEP medium with rifampicin as a blank to check OD600.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend Agrobacterium
steps.instruction: Prepare the dipping solution by harvesting the cells and resuspending them in a sucrose-surfactant mixture.

substeps.instruction: Harvest Agro cells by centrifugation at 4000 rpm for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in a solution of 5% sucrose and 0.05% Silwet L-77 surfactant (50 μl per 100 ml) to achieve a final OD600 of 0.8.

steps.title: Perform floral dip transformation
steps.instruction: Transform the plants when secondary inflorescences are 1-10 cm tall (6-8 days after clipping).

substeps.instruction: Invert plants and dip all above-ground parts into the Agro solution, shaking gently for 5 seconds.
Let the solution drip off for about 30 seconds, then place plants right side up.
Lay plants horizontally in a tray and cover with an opaque lid misted with water (or a tall saran-wrap dome).
Incubate in the dark for 12-24 hours to retain humidity.
Return plants to vertical position and grow as normal.
Optional: Repeat the dip 4-5 days later with a new culture for higher efficiency.

steps.title: Collect T1 seeds
steps.instruction: Grow the transformed plants in a low light chamber for 3-5 weeks after removing the cover until T1 seeds can be collected.

steps.title: Generate T2 generation
steps.instruction: Grow T1 seeds (hemizygous) and allow them to self-pollinate to produce T2 seeds containing +/+, +/-, and -/- genotypes.

steps.title: Select T2 homozygous candidates
steps.instruction: Screen T2 seeds using a selection agent (e.g., BASTA) based on the resistance gene.

substeps.instruction: Select seeds under BASTA to identify surviving seedlings (T2).
Identify plants that are either homozygous (+/+) or hemizygous (+/-), noting the expected ratio of 1:2 for +/+: +/-.
Harvest seeds from individual plants, ensuring no cross-contamination between plants.

steps.title: Confirm and establish T3 homozygous lines
steps.instruction: Perform a final selection on seeds from individual T2 plants to identify homozygous lines.

substeps.instruction: Perform BASTA selection on seeds from different individual T2 plants.
Identify plates where all seedlings survive; these are derived from +/+ T2 plants.
Keep these T3 seedlings as confirmed homozygous (+/+) lines.
